cues.text: You already get bid alerts. So why would you need me?
An alert is automated. It fires on keywords.
It tells you something exists, and it stops there.
It can't tell you the site meeting is mandatory.
Or that the bonding is beyond you.
Or that an addendum just moved the closing date.
And it misses the work that was titled in a way you'd never search.
I'm a person who reads the documents, and tells you whether it's worth your time. That's the part software can't do.
Alerts tell you it exists. I tell you if it fits.
Book a discovery call at phildave.com.
